work.title: Readela on Firefox for Android: the Firefox package declares Firefox for Android, nothing fails where Android lacks keyboard commands, and the documents say so
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner choice of 2026-10-31 to start Firefox for Android support, recorded in ENT-293. It is the one go-ahead for a new platform and covers: the manifest change for Firefox for Android, the code guards it needs, tests for them, and the matching changes to docs/privacy-and-permissions.md, docs/privacy-policy.md, README.md and docs/store-listing.md. It does not authorize: a new permission, host, match pattern or stored form; raising the version; a tag or a release; any store submission or change of a live listing; Chrome for Android or any other Android browser.

parentPreflight.reason: The 0.3.0 records cover work that is integrated and released, and each places Firefox for Android out of scope. This is a new bounded work unit, so it carries its own light assertion.

inScope: This record, committed first on the working branch from baseCommit.
src/manifest/firefox.json: browser_specific_settings.gecko_android with a minimum version.
src/background and src/ui: no failure, and no misleading text, where the browser offers no keyboard commands.
A unit test for the background component without commands.
docs/privacy-and-permissions.md, docs/privacy-policy.md, README.md and docs/store-listing.md: Firefox for Android described as it is.
Dated evidence under docs/evidence/ of what was checked, in which browser and version, and what was not.
outOfScope: Permissions, host access, match patterns, web-accessible resources, stored forms, fonts, icons and the version number.
The Chrome package and Chrome for Android.
Site adapters, unless the owner's check on a phone shows a reading defect that needs them; that would be reported first.
A tag, a release, an AMO submission or any change of a live store listing.
Changes to declared Capabilities or Exceptions, the dev-standards pin and the repository ruleset.

assessment.projectStartedOrResumed: The project was Paused between releases with no open development and is resumed for this bounded unit; the code, the baseline and the governance are unchanged since the 0.3.0 release, which had full records, so a full Preflight would repeat them.
assessment.baselineIdentityChanged: No. dev-standards v0.6.0 at f35e1025bf6cc0fcedbf7528b41a00ceaebf04d8, effective policy sha256:b671fdd9a246661e047d243a5611baecca1aaaa0baf85aa2398caee48c6da692; the verifier passed on baseCommit on 2026-10-31.
assessment.protocolChanged: Revision v1.25 since the last record (v1.23). v1.24 and v1.25 state that no Preflight, Gate, work-unit, review or close-out semantics changed.
assessment.architectureOrTrustBoundaryChanged: No. The same package, permissions (storage and the two sites), data-collection declaration and add-on id are offered to one more Firefox build. Firefox for Android grants the requested permissions at installation, as desktop Firefox does for these two sites.
assessment.scopeExpandedBeyondCurrentPreflight: Not applicable; no parent is being worked under.
